David usually has rice for breakfast. David's favorite animal is the dog. David wants to be a teacher in the future. What's more, flamingos stand in the shallow lake.
There are always many people at the bird-watching spot. Lily is interested in swimming. Last Wednesday, David and Lily went to the city park. Also, a rabbit hid behind the bush.
The city park is one of the best places in the city. David hopes to visit Xi'an one day. The weather was rainy that day. The rain stops at noon.
David and Lily had great fun there. It takes twenty minutes to get to the city park by bike. David learned a lot about history.
